caption:
Want Tokyo's Senso-ji without the crowds? 🏮
Skip midday. Go early, or after dinner.

🥇 Early morning
🚶 The temple grounds never close.
🏮 Walk Nakamise before the shops open.
⛩️ Go inside the main hall in peace.
🍲 Then have a miso soup breakfast
at MISOJYU, a short walk away.

🥈 After dinner
✨ The gates, pagoda and main hall are lit up.
🖼️ The closed shops show painted shutters.
📸 The hall is shut at night,
so this visit is for photos and a slow walk.

💡 Free view
Go up to the free 8th-floor terrace of the
Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center.
It's right opposite Kaminarimon gate.

🎭 Nearby, a theatre has rakugo, Japanese comic
storytelling, every day of the year.
DM us SENSOJI and we'll send you where.
